title: Synthesis of core/shell cobalt-doped rutile TiO2 nanorods for MB degradation under visible light
content:

Core/shell cobalt-doped rutile TiO2 nanorods were prepared via a one-pot molten salt flux method, exhibiting photocatalytic activity for MB under visible light.
